#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

enum class State { OUTSIDE, INSIDE };

pair<int, int> documentAnalyser(const string& doc) {
    State state = State::OUTSIDE;
    bool lastWasLetter = false;
    int longest = 0;
    int curLen = 0;
    int words = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < doc.length(); i++) {
        char c = doc[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            state = State::INSIDE;
            lastWasLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            state = State::OUTSIDE;
            lastWasLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        } else if (isalpha(c)) {
            if (state == State::INSIDE && !lastWasLetter) {
                words++;
            } else if (state == State::OUTSIDE) {
                curLen++;
                if (curLen > longest) longest = curLen;
            }
            lastWasLetter = true;
        } else {
            lastWasLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        }
    }
    return make_pair(longest, words);
}

int main() {
    int length;
    cin >> length;
    string data;
    cin >> data;
    pair<int, int> result = documentAnalyser(data);
    cout << result.first << " " << result.second;
    return 0;
}
